caseName: McDaniel v. Georgia Ass'n of Retarded Citizens
caseNameFull: McDaniel v. Georgia Association of Retarded Citizens and Board of Public Education for the City of Savannah and the County of Chatham v. Georgia Association of Retarded Citizens

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Motion of National School Boards Association et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae in No. 83-1431 granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and cases remanded for further consideration in light of Smith v. Robinson, ante, p. 992. Reported below: 716 F. 2d 1565.
